claim_scope: Portioning with streamed harvest against the hard-cap-plus-reserve baseline, on one PHP subject at 500 regions, 3600 s.
reading: A mixed result, told straight. Findings are IDENTICAL, 125 either way -- the detection output does not change. Completion is slightly LOWER under portioning, 131 of 406 against 153, and it used more wall time, 2,982 s against 2,338. So on this subject portioning does not beat hard-cap-plus-reserve on throughput; it matches it on what it finds.
what_portioning_actually_buys: Kill-safety, which is what the maintainer asked for. Under the hard cap a batch killed at the ceiling loses every answer it computed; under streaming it keeps them. The two approaches reaching the same 125 findings is the evidence that streaming loses nothing the cap kept -- and it no longer discards a near-complete batch's work when the ceiling falls mid-answer. The completion gap is not a detection gap.
why_completion_did_not_rise: The requeue re-asks a killed portion's remainder, and on this subject those remainders are the expensive output-encoding questions that keep hitting the ceiling in smaller and smaller pieces, spending budget without completing. The arbitration reserve then stops the query phase (query_budget_reserved) with those still unresolved. A cap that simply drops them, plus the reserve, happened to leave more budget for the questions that could complete. Honest read: requeue helps a transient kill and does not help a genuinely-too-expensive family, and telling those apart is the next lever, not more portioning.
neither_is_release_ready: 131 or 153 of 406 is 32-38% completion on a bounded 500-region PHP run; the M4 gate is 95%. Neither approach makes PHP release-qualifying, and this subject is development data that qualifies nothing. The value delivered here is robustness of the engine path, not a PHP capability.
limits: One subject, one language, one budget. The comparison may invert on a repository whose expensive family is rarer.
The reserve share and the portion target are first values, not tuned; the completion gap is within the range those could move.
